Detailed observation separates the parts of an emotional response and makes patterns easier to understand.

For a cross-curriculum skills-selection reference, use the [Emotional Overload & Emotional Numbness Skills Guide](/resources/general/general-p004.jpg), which also remains available in [Skill Finder](/skill-finder/).
